description.value: Island Farm To Table is a four-generation family-run organic farm and bakery on Quadra Island, drawing on 57 years of farming heritage rooted in Vernon, B.C. and Austria. Visitors can sample locally grown meats, fruits, and vegetables prepared as farm-to-table fare, and the property also offers farm stays and a sauna with cold shower. Quadra Island itself is accessible by ferry and is known for hiking, beaches, and a relaxed island pace.
